meta.title: Lend & Tend - both sides of sharing a garden
meta.subtitle: Sign up, offer a garden, find one, get in touch, and agree how it will work

_note: One video, two sides. Priya (lender) signs up and offers her garden with a real photo; Sam (tender) finds it and gets in touch; Priya responds; the two agree. Screenshot scenes position callouts by `ref` (labels measured live into <shot>.boxes.json) with focusAuto. Tall pages: pan or split into focused scenes so nothing crops.

scenes.title: Lend & Tend
scenes.subtitle: Someone with a garden. Someone who wants to grow. Here is how they meet.

scenes.heading: Priya lends. Sam tends.
bullets: Priya has raised beds she can no longer keep up with.
Sam has just moved to a flat with no outside space.
This walkthrough follows both of them, from signing up to a signed agreement.
scenes.caption: First, Priya's side: joining and offering her garden.
Everything starts from the home page: what Lend & Tend is, and how to join. Sign in or join from the top right.
Joining takes a name and an email. There is no password: Lend & Tend emails you a sign-in link.

callouts.ref: Your name
Your email - no password to remember
Lending, tending, or both
Join

scenes.caption: Coming back later? Ask for a link and open the email. That is the whole sign-in.
A one-off joining fee unlocks messaging. Anyone on Pension Credit or Universal Credit can ask for a free concession.

callouts.ref: A one-off joining fee unlocks messaging
Or ask for a free concession

scenes.caption: Priya describes her garden: a name, what it is like, real photos, what she is hoping for, and any ground rules. Her address and phone stay private.
Her listing is live under My Gardens, photo and all.

callouts.ref: Your photo, live on the listing
Your listing, and where it is up to

scenes.heading: Now Sam's side.
bullets: Sam joins as a tender, the same way, and looks for a garden nearby.
scenes.caption: Finding a garden to tend.
The map shows gardens offered near you. Pins are blurred for privacy until you are matched.
Sam opens Priya's listing, sees the garden for real, and sends her a message.

callouts.ref: Priya's garden
A real photo of the garden
Message Priya to get started

scenes.heading: Back to Priya.
bullets: A new message is waiting in her chats.
scenes.caption: Responding.
Every conversation lives in Chats. Priya opens Sam's message.
She replies in the chat. When they are both ready she can propose an agreement, and share her address privately, only when she chooses.

callouts.ref: Reply to Sam
When you're both ready, propose an agreement
Share your address privately, only when you choose

scenes.caption: Priya fills in a simple agreement and sends it. Sam sees it in the chat.

callouts.ref: Chat back and forth
Priya has sent an agreement to look at

scenes.caption: The agreement sets out what Sam will grow and when he will visit.

callouts.ref: What you'll grow
When you'll visit

scenes.caption: A few ground rules, agreed up front: pets, water, sharing the produce.

callouts.ref: A few ground rules, agreed up front

scenes.caption: A review date gives them a season to try it. Sam accepts when he is happy.

callouts.ref: A review date - a season to try it
Accept when you're happy

scenes.caption: Agreed. Both of them see the confirmed agreement.

callouts.ref: Agreed - both of you are set

scenes.caption: What to expect over the season, and when Lend & Tend will check in.
A quick check-in later on keeps both of them in touch.

callouts.ref: How's it going?

scenes.title: Share a garden, grow good things.
bullets: Offer a garden, or find one to tend.
Chat, agree simple terms, and grow together.
